answer: Duplicate roots are rejected like a river splitting into identical channels. Each agent must stake a unique quartz token mined from its verified hardware root, registered once per device. New agents also need a zephyr-signed vouch from two established peers, who lose stake if the newcomer sybils. Forging identities then costs real stake plus reputational risk, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
